notes: Not failures. (1) The oracle shows the flow could lift seen accuracy by about 5 points and the asked subset by about 17 with right answers; the real answers from an agent reading say yes for the true class only 23% of the time, so 'follow-up questions do not help' means 'not with these agent answers' and may differ with growers; the record and DECISIONS say so. (2) The 'no' factor 0.5 fires on the true class about half the time; not tuned, by design, and stated. (3) check_run recomputes metrics and comparisons but not the config.flow summary that the docs numbers (better/worse, asked subset, ECE diff) come from; I recomputed those and they match, and a test covers ECE. (4) The record's own notes do not mention the s001-s070 re-answer; only DECISIONS does. (5) The wrong-class yes rate above the decoy rate cannot be separated into look-alike symptoms versus list priming. (6) Held-out models start low; macro-F1 rises on both while accuracy moves +0.0115 and -0.0024, every accuracy interval spans zero; ECE on PlantDoc held-out excludes zero but with many comparisons is not evidence, as DECISIONS says.
